name: What common home improvements can help attract multiple offers?

mainEntity.name: What common home improvements can help attract multiple offers?

acceptedAnswer.text: To attract multiple offers, focus on improvements that enhance curb appeal and key interior spaces like kitchens and bathrooms. Fresh paint, decluttering, and professional staging can significantly impact buyer perception. Consider minor repairs and updates to fixtures that present a well-maintained home. Kelby Contreras advises focusing on high-impact, low-cost improvements, as extensive renovations may not always yield a proportional return in a competitive market.
acceptedAnswer.description: Focus on curb appeal, updated kitchens and bathrooms, fresh paint, decluttering, and professional staging to attract multiple offers.
